request.prompt: Create exactly one isolated full-body Rachni Brood Warrior from original Mass Effect 1, faithfully reproducing the supplied actual in-game screenshot. Preserve the precise slightly elevated frontal three-quarter pose and the asymmetric silhouette: dark purple segmented body, low heavy central abdomen with its muted red-purple underside, pointed layered head, cyan-white luminous markings on the head and ridged back, short clawed appendages near the mouth, and the same jointed pointed walking legs and their overlaps. Carefully preserve the TWO long arched appendages: the one sweeping out toward image left with its long tapered flattened end, and the one looping toward image right with its foreshortened bulbous end. Keep both complete and preserve their curved routes and unequal apparent lengths. Match the reference anatomy, arrangement, palette and proportions rather than turning it into a Rachni Worker, generic insect, symmetrical crab or redesign. Do not invent eyes, extra tentacles, spikes, limbs, armor, wings, fluid or new details. Keep the original game's restrained surface detail; improve readability only enough to make the existing dark purple forms distinguishable. Maintain the original pose and perspective, retaining natural occlusion of hidden rear parts. Exactly one complete creature with both long appendage tips, all visible legs and the mouth fully inside the canvas, with at least 10 percent transparent margin on all sides. Remove cave, ground and ground shadow. Real transparent alpha background; no scene, pedestal, text, border, halo or contact shadow. One subject and one view, no sheet or collage.
